note: What each species does to light, 380-780 nm (GAME_SPEC §12). absorb: molar absorptivity in L/mol/cm, a sum of Gaussian bands in wavenumber (centre and full width at half maximum in 1/cm). reflect: diffuse reflectance, a base plus Gaussian bands in wavelength (exp(-((nm - centre) / width)^2)). transmit: the transmittance of a wall at its reference thickness, a base plus a logistic rise at an edge. Every number here is calibrated to the colour the substance has, not measured: docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.
